ciStability: Nearest-rank p95 of five local samples is the maximum sample. CI runners differ in CPU, cache, and load. Numeric gates would flake before they would catch a genuine regression. CI keeps structural boundedness: zero SQLite, zero HTTP, corpus digest bind, conserved OperationLedger, deterministic artifact bytes, and no raw URLs.
headroom: No reviewed headroom multiple exists. Wall-clock samples are evidence, not a budget. Domain-pairwise identity comparison over the full catalog is too expensive for CI and is not used as a gate.
representativeness: The T135 corpus binds every frozen runtime source record and all 16 adapter identities by count and digest without copying locators. The harness executes those six CPU stages against the live packaged inventory. Two catalog locators are not public HTTPS and remain invalid occurrences. Shared portfolio hosts produce domain-level identity collisions; catalog uniqueness is key/owner/adapter closure plus O(n) exact identity grouping, not O(n^2) domain pairing.
variance: Repeated odd-count local runs record integer median, nearest-rank p95, and range in microseconds. Variance is expected across machines and is not a pass/fail input.
